core_obligations: An exact Gaussian kernel on an abstract Dirichlet metric space does not initially supply smooth coordinates or even an integer dimension. The author heat-semigroup and distance-function analysis reconstructs the Euclidean geometry and measure, then controls heat-kernel limits under metric convergence to obtain the quantitative almost-rigidity statement without assuming a Riemannian structure.
